## Choose the column that answers the question {#l2-recap .compact}

| Need to find… | Use… |
|:---|:---|
| Total number of observations | $n=\sum f$ |
| Mean | $\bar{x}=\dfrac{\sum fx}{\sum f}$ |
| Mode; range | Largest $f$; maximum observed $x$ minus minimum observed $x$ |
| Median | $cf$ to locate the middle observation(s), then read their $x$-values |
| Proportion with exactly one value | $rf=f/n$ |
| Count; proportion at or below a value | $cf$; $crf=cf/n$ |
| Quartiles; IQR | Ordered positions or calculator; $Q_3-Q_1$ |

::: {.takeaway}
Cumulative means **counted so far**. Check calculator entries using $n$.
:::

::: notes
Return to the success criterion: explain the columns and find/check statistics. Exit prompts: What does a cumulative frequency of35 atx=1 mean? Why can we not use the tallest cumulative bar to identify the mode? Why might an ogive estimate differ from the exact median in a discrete table? Answers:35 observations at or below1; cumulative bars are running totals; joining upper-boundary points interpolates within a bin.
:::
